description: Signed invite acceptance. The acceptor generates its own relationship X25519 keypair and SSH deploy key locally; only public keys leave its machine. No peer private key is ever included.

deploy_public_key.description: Acceptor's SSH deploy public key (OpenSSH format). Public material only.

invite_hash.description: Base64url (no padding) SHA-256 of the restricted-JCS bytes of the invite this acceptance answers.

invite_id.description: Lowercase canonical UUIDv4 of the invite.

relationship_agreement_key.description: Acceptor's fresh relationship X25519 public key, multibase base58btc.

signature.description: Base64url (no padding) Ed25519 signature by the acceptor over the restricted-JCS bytes of the acceptance with signature omitted.

title: Invite acceptance
